english.title: Disclose details of manufacturing process or trade secret obtained by virtue of powers under Water Industry Act 1991
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been admitted to premises in compliance with a

(A)_[provision of the Water Industry Act 1991 relating to a right of entry to which Part 1 of Schedule 6 to the Act applied]_
(B)_[warrant under Part 1 of Schedule 6 to the Water Industry Act 1991]_

disclosed information obtained by you there with regard to a

(C)_[manufacturing process]_
(D)_[trade secret]_
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 5(1) and (4) of Schedule 6 to the Water Industry Act 1991.
